PURITA Phuket Bangtao

Condominium in Bang Tao (Cherngtalay)
HomeNew ProjectsPURITA Phuket Bangtao

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

PURITA Phuket Bangtao is a new condominium by CG Capital, the investment arm of the family behind Central Group, on a 10-rai plot in Cherngtalay. It has four six-storey buildings and one villa around a courtyard garden with a 50-metre pool, with 258 furnished units in total. Apartments are one-bedroom, two-bedroom and two-bedroom-plus types from 56.4 to 136 sqm. Completion is announced for November 2028.

Facilities & amenities

  • 50-metre swimming pool
  • 3-rai courtyard garden
  • Lobby with lounge and patio
  • Co-working space and meeting rooms
  • Fitness centre
  • Changing rooms with private steam rooms
  • Drop-off area
  • Parking for 125 cars
  • One year of concierge service included

Frequently asked questions

Where is PURITA Phuket Bangtao?

PURITA Phuket Bangtao is a low-rise condominium project in Bang Tao (Cherngtalay), Phuket, developed by CG Capital.

What is the starting price of PURITA Phuket Bangtao?

Agent advertised price is ฿7,997,000, last checked 2026-11-14. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at PURITA Phuket Bangtao?

Sources list freehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will PURITA Phuket Bangtao be ready?

Current status: pre-sale; completion date listed as November 2028. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
